meta_description: Everything you need to know before the event: location, transport, food, accommodation, safety and what to bring.
subtitle: Everything you need to know before you set off for Middle-earth.
card.misto.title: Location & travel
card.misto.desc: Camp near Brno — registered participants receive exact GPS 14 days before the event. About a 20-minute walk from the bus stop.
card.strava.title: Food & drink
card.strava.desc: We do not directly arrange catering. There will be a partnered pub on site — U Zeleného draka — that can serve meals. Your own food supply, plate, cutlery and mug recommended.
card.ubytovani.title: Accommodation
card.ubytovani.desc: Your own tent within your army’s camp. Parking, toilets and showers are available.
card.bezpecnost.title: Safety
card.bezpecnost.desc: Permanent medic. Everything goes through a safety check (cek). Rule of zero — STOP halts the game.
pack.1: Approved larp weapon (will pass the cek)
pack.5: Your own mess kit (plate, cutlery, mug)
har.title: Weekend schedule
har.subtitle: It’s not just the Saturday battle. The event starts on Thursday and ends on Sunday.
har.thu_what: Arrival, camp setup, registration, first meetings, evening fire
har.fri_what: Camp play, side programme, children’s game, market, arenas
har.sat_what_post: , muster, approvals, armies marching out, in-game clashes
thu.p1: Thursday opens the weekend. The first participants arrive, the camp is set up, registration takes place and people start settling into their armies and warbands.
thu.p2: Thursday is ideal for those who want to arrive at a calm pace, pitch a tent, meet others and tune into the weekend without Saturday’s rush.
thu.li1: arrival on site, parking by instruction,
thu.li3: meeting your army, evening fire and camp atmosphere.
fri.h3: Friday 21 Aug — The camp comes alive
fri.p1: Friday isn’t the main battle. It’s the day the camp turns into a lively place full of preparations, programme, meetings and smaller games. Suitable for newcomers, families with children, escorts, photographers.
fri.li1: play in the camp, side programme,
fri.li2: children’s game, market and stalls, arenas,
sat.p1: Saturday is the main day. Muster takes place, rules are explained, latecomers register, weapons and costumes are checked, armies are summoned and the main game / battle takes place.
sat.li2: assignment of lives based on costume,
sat.li3: armies marching out, main in-game clashes,
sun.p1: On Sunday camp is packed up, the area is cleaned and participants head home. Help with the cleanup is welcome and goes a long way to making sure only flattened grass is left after the event.
sun.li1: packing the tent, cleaning the camp,
sun.li2: taking out rubbish, checking the area,
har.alert_strong: It’s not just the Saturday battle.
har.alert_post: If you can, come for the whole weekend — it’s easier to get into your army, meet people, prepare your gear and experience the atmosphere that simply doesn’t fit into Saturday alone.
key.title: Key information
eq.title: What to bring
eq.alert_warn_body: Every participant goes through a mandatory weapon and costume safety check on arrival. Without approval you can’t play.
eq.alert_info_body: Participants under 18 must bring written consent from a legal guardian. You’ll find a template in the Registration section.
food.title: Food & drink
food.p1: As organisers we don’t directly provide catering. Each participant is responsible for their own food and drink.
food.p2_pre: To make the stay more comfortable, we’re arranging the on-site pub
food.p2_post: , where you’ll be able to buy food and drink from their menu and operating capacity.
food.p3: We recommend bringing your own basic reserve of food and drink, especially if:
food.li5: you know that without a second dinner you turn into an orc.
food.note: Drinking water will be available on site from a delivered tank. Don’t expect showers, electricity or the comfort of the inn at Rivendell — we’re on a meadow, in nature.
kids.title: Children’s game
kids.p_pre: For younger participants we’re preparing a separate children’s game. It runs apart from the main battle and is adapted to the age, safety and capabilities of children. The main game is for
stalls.title: Stalls and market
stalls.p: On site you’ll find themed gear — costumes, fabrics, leather accessories, jewellery, weapons. Organisers don’t guarantee availability of specific items; if you need something specific, arrange it with the vendor in advance.
reg.title: Registration and payment — quick overview

reg.s2_pre: Instructions by e-mail within 10 days of registration. With payment your reservation becomes
